reconcile.note: John Gill reads Deuteronomy's curse on lawbreakers as the very burden Paul presses in Galatians, since perfect obedience is what the law demands and no one supplies.

sides.snippet: Cursed be he who doesn't confirm the words of this law to do them. All the people shall say, Amen.
sides.verseText: Cursed be he who doesn't confirm the words of this law to do them. All the people shall say, Amen.

sides.snippet: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse.
sides.verseText: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, \"Cursed is everyone who doesn't continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.\"
